definition: A law, decree or binding regulation, issued by a government or regulator, that obliges others to address climate resilience or emissions. Choose this over the others when the instrument is binding.

A technical code, standard, specification or guideline that applies to infrastructure beyond this project (for example, national standards for climate-resilient network deployment). Does not include laws or regulations, or a requirement on this project's own works only.

A procedure that makes climate risk part of how future investments are planned, screened or approved (for example, public investment management rules or sector master plans). Does not include laws, technical standards or general strategies.

Formal operating rules or protocols that require services to keep functioning or respond during climate shocks (continuity of operations, emergency procedures). Does not include laws, technical standards, planning procedures or strategies.

A sector policy, strategy or action plan that sets climate-related direction without being a law, regulation, technical standard, planning procedure or operating protocol. Choose this only when none of those applies.
